sources.excerpt: Search actions incur a tool call cost
50% cost discount compared to synchronous APIs
Batch and Flex are priced at 50% of Standard rates.

limitations: Parent model tokens are separately priced from their pinned profile. Search open_page/find_in_page actions are not charged as new searches.
Container sessions: table quotes per20minutes, eligible sessions perminute with5minute minimum. Container IDs alone cannot establish billed duration; costs remain unresolved.
File search storage includes account-level1GB free allocation; individual vector-store size snapshots do not establish billed GB-days. Storage is tracked unresolved.
Image tool result bytes do not establish independent parent/tool token attribution; outputs retained, cost unresolved without authoritative usage.
Batch only enabled for exact separately verified model aliases; no tools or streaming in initial text-only interface. No live hosted-tool or batch calls made.
